description: A large white mosque with a tall, square, tiled minaret and green-tiled roofs stands on a rocky shore while surf breaks against the rocks under a stormy sky. In the foreground, several men in robes and turbans or caps sit on the ground assembling geometric tile mosaics, with stacks of tiles and tile fragments around them. A carved, ornamented stone or plaster archway fills the right edge of the frame.
